authority: Existing trusted tenant/user identity, member Workplace capability, verified group membership, current site VIEW and delegated ACCESS_MANAGE/CATALOG_MANAGE or global tenant administrator; review POST is read-only, changes POST is guarded write
limitations: No fabricated live people, external health, connector endpoint fetching, SLO/instant anonymization claims, or prediction simulation. Retention uses existing wp_tenant_policies.booking_retention_days.
facilityRetentionSemantics: Current native tenant bookingRetentionDays applies: terminal RESOLVED/CANCELLED requests after updatedAt+days; closures after max(endsAt,updatedAt)+days. Keep active requests, current/future periods, overlapping legal-held booking intervals and protected/in-flight audit evidence. Retained native facility audit metadata has explicit FACILITY_PERSONAL_DATA_REDACTED snapshots with actor/correlation cleared; sanitize native audit outbox copies and remove original ingested central audit PII rows. No inferred historical impacts or external replica deletion guarantee.

floorAccessOverlay.authority: Existing ADMIN.WORKPLACE native permission and SITE ACCESS_MANAGE delegation; no additional grant or registry activation
floorAccessOverlay.evaluation: Require existing SITE allow first; no active/current FLOOR rules inherits SITE; configured FLOOR rules require matching USER or verified GROUP_REF ALLOW, explicit DENY wins; FLOOR ALLOW never opens SITE navigation
floorAccessOverlay.commandSafety: Tenant/site/floor FK + owner path validation; version and immutable scope; reason/confirmed atomic reviewed changes and audit; exact tenant/site transaction advisory lock shared with BOOK commands
floorAccessOverlay.rolloutGuard: UI must match requested floor UUID with native review.proposed.floorId and currentActorAccess/proposedActorAccess.floorId/siteId; absent/mismatched producer prevents dispatch; legacy direct save is unused by native editor
